security_audit.summary: Seven command findings are confirmed because the skill directs users or agents to invoke remote CLI operations, including package installation and media generation. Markdown fence matches, ordinary reference links, and alleged reconnaissance text are false positives. A broad belt command permission is an additional medium-risk capability.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends installing dependencies with unpinned npx commands.
remediation.suggestion: Pin each skill dependency to a reviewed version or immutable commit and require user confirmation before installation.

remediation.issue: Installation guidance points to a mutable raw file on the main branch.
remediation.suggestion: Link to a versioned release document and publish checksums or signatures for downloaded tooling.

remediation.issue: The allowed-tools declaration permits every belt subcommand.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict allowed commands to the specific belt app operations required for video generation and processing.

content.value_statement: Video ad requirements differ across platforms, causing costly formatting and creative mistakes. This skill provides specifications, timed structures, caption guidance, and production prompts.
actual_capabilities: Provides aspect ratios, resolutions, durations, and safe-zone guidance for five major advertising platforms.
Structures short video concepts with the Attention, Interest, Desire, and Action framework.
Creates timed outlines for testimonial, demonstration, before-and-after, and bumper ads.
Recommends captions, voiceovers, hooks, calls to action, and sound-off design choices.
Supplies belt CLI examples for generating video, speech, merged audio, and burned-in captions.
limitations: Platform requirements can change, so current publisher documentation remains authoritative.
The skill does not verify ad policy compliance, legal claims, licensing, or audience targeting.
Media generation examples require the external belt CLI, an account, and supported remote applications.
The skill provides production guidance but does not measure campaign performance or conversion results.

prompt_templates.title: Create a TikTok Ad Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15-second TikTok ad plan for [product]. Include 9:16 specifications, a one-second hook, captions, scene timing, and a clear CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Social Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt [source concept] for Instagram Reels, Stories, and Facebook Feed. Provide aspect ratio, duration, safe zones, captions, and platform-specific changes.

prompt_templates.title: Build AIDA Storyboards
prompt_templates.prompt: Build AIDA storyboards for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn for [offer]. Include timed scenes, voiceover, overlays, accessibility notes, and production prompts.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Creative Test Matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a test matrix for [campaign] across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Compare hooks, formats, lengths, CTAs, and success hypotheses.

output_examples.input: Plan a 15-second TikTok ad for a compact wireless charger.
output: Format: 9:16 at 1080 by 1920 pixels, with essential text kept inside the safe zone.
0-3 seconds: Show tangled cables and ask, "Still charging like this?"
3-12 seconds: Reveal the charger, demonstrate three devices, and add concise captions.
12-15 seconds: Show the product name and the CTA, "Simplify your desk today."

output_examples.input: Adapt a software demo for LinkedIn and YouTube bumper ads.
output: LinkedIn: Use a professional square or widescreen edit with captions and a 20-second problem-to-result structure.
YouTube bumper: Use one widescreen visual, one benefit, and one CTA within exactly six seconds.
Keep branding near the end and make both versions understandable without sound.

output_examples.input: Review my vertical ad checklist before production.
output_examples.output: Confirm 9:16 delivery, an immediate hook, readable captions, protected safe zones, sound-off clarity, platform duration, and a visible final CTA.

best_practices: Verify current platform specifications before final export because requirements can change.
Design for silent viewing with readable captions, strong contrast, and meaningful visuals.
Create distinct platform versions with suitable framing, duration, tone, and safe zones.
anti_patterns: Do not reuse one landscape export across vertical feeds.
Do not delay the hook or CTA beyond the expected viewing window.
Do not place essential text beneath platform controls or outside safe zones.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers TikTok, Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, YouTube, Facebook Feed, and LinkedIn.

faq.question: Can it generate finished video files?
faq.answer: It provides belt CLI examples that can call external media applications when the required service and account are available.

faq.question: Does it provide scripts and storyboards?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure hooks, scenes, voiceovers, captions, benefits, and calls to action using timed formats.

faq.question: Are the platform specifications guaranteed current?
faq.answer: No. Platform rules change, so verify final dimensions, durations, file limits, and policies with each publisher.

faq.question: Does it check advertising policy compliance?
faq.answer: No. Review claims, disclosures, rights, targeting, and restricted-content rules separately before publishing.

faq.question: Why are captions emphasized?
faq.answer: Many social videos autoplay without sound. Captions preserve the message and improve accessibility for more viewers.
